svg.title: The natural golden dome — earth-ionosphere Schumann cavity as layered resonant shield
svg.desc: Illustrative cross-section showing the earth's surface, the biosphere including human scale, the troposphere, and the ionospheric conducting shell forming the Schumann cavity. Schumann mode standing waves occupy the cavity. The 432 Hz subharmonic bridge and the 8 Hz alpha/Schumann coincidence are annotated. Lightning bolts drive the cavity from within. The grounding rod array couples the fabric into the dome from below.
